author: Praxis II
title: Auto‑GHS DAQB: Label‑free tuning of density‑adaptive quotas and shrinkage in EtC–BRBG
abstract: We define a label‑free Graph Health Score (GHS) combining per‑cell cross‑batch mixing, cap utilization, density–mixing coupling, entropy, and implementation checks. On a batch‑stratified subsample, we grid‑search (λ, δ, k_density) for DAQB using GHS, then rebuild the full graph with the best settings. Graphs are binary with true distances; BRBG is unchanged. Hypothesis: match or exceed fixed δ=0.15, k_density=20 with improved robustness across environments.
